restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: LSASS memory access or dumping (e.g., procdump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump, Mimikatz), SAM/SECURITY hive or NTDS.dit extraction, credential-store access (DPAPI, browser/credential manager files), Kerberoasting/AS-REP roasting, or suspicious access to lsass.exe by non-standard processes.
what_would_refute: No evidence of credential-dumping tooling or LSASS access, no unauthorized reads of SAM/SECURITY/NTDS.dit or credential stores, and no anomalous authentication artifacts consistent with stolen credentials.
